operations.label: Keyword relevance ranking
operations.scope: Calculate ordinary keyword relevance with default similarity on a text field without a custom model.

operations.label: Nearest-neighbor retrieval with a supplied vector
operations.scope: Retrieve nearest indexed vectors with the knn query. Numeric query and index vectors are already supplied. Their upstream generation and index-training modes are outside scope.

operations.label: Text embedding in a locally served ingest configuration
operations.scope: The text_embedding processor has been configured with the ID of a text embedding model deployed locally in this self-managed OpenSearch cluster.

operations.label: Amazon Bedrock Titan text embedding
operations.scope: The external Amazon Bedrock Titan operation when the documented Titan connector configuration is selected. Assess execution of the embedding itself.

operations.label: Configured connector request dispatch
operations.scope: The OpenSearch ML Commons transport for a registered remote connector, limited to constructing and dispatching the configured request and receiving its response. The scenario assesses two configurations separately, the documented Titan connector and a custom HTTP endpoint.

operations.label: Configured private endpoint response
operations.scope: The actual implementation inside a particular organization-owned service reached through the custom HTTP connector. A response carrying a vector is given, but no implementation, model identity or provider log is supplied. Do not infer from the behavior of the OpenSearch connector itself.

operations.label: Hybrid search score normalization
operations.scope: Normalize and combine existing query scores with the normalization processor. Query generation and any model upstream of those scores are outside scope.
